targets.query:
from(bucket: "ana-lab")
  |> range(start: -2m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "net_device_health" and
    (
      r._field == "cpu_util_pct" or
      r._field == "memory_util_pct" or
      r._field == "uptime_seconds"
    ) and
    r.device != "R5"
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with
    _value: float(v: r._value)
  }))
  |> group()
  |> pivot(
    rowKey: ["device", "vendor", "mgmt_ip"],
    columnKey: ["_field"],
    valueColumn: "_value"
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with
    uptime_human:
      string(v: int(v: r.uptime_seconds) / 86400) + "d " +
      string(v: (int(v: r.uptime_seconds) % 86400) / 3600) + "h " +
      string(v: (int(v: r.uptime_seconds) % 3600) / 60) + "m"
  }))

from(bucket: "ana-lab")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "net_ifstate" and
    r._field == "oper_status" and
    r.device != "R5"
  )
  |> group(columns: ["device", "interface"])
  |> last()

|> map(fn: (r) => ({
  r with
  id:
    if (
      (r.device == "R3" and r.interface == "GigabitEthernet2") or
      (r.device == "R4" and r.interface == "GigabitEthernet2")
    ) then "R3-R4"

    else if (
      (r.device == "R3" and r.interface == "GigabitEthernet4") or
      (r.device == "S3" and r.interface == "Ethernet3")
    ) then "R3-S3"

    else if (
      (r.device == "R4" and r.interface == "GigabitEthernet3") or
      (r.device == "S4" and r.interface == "ethernet-1/2")
    ) then "R4-S4"

    else if (
      (r.device == "S3" and r.interface == "Ethernet1") or
      (r.device == "S4" and r.interface == "ethernet-1/1")
    ) then "S3-S4"

    else if (
      (r.device == "R1" and r.interface == "Ethernet2") or
      (r.device == "S3" and r.interface == "Ethernet2")
    ) then "R1-S3"

    else if (
      (r.device == "R2" and r.interface == "Ethernet3") or
      (r.device == "S4" and r.interface == "ethernet-1/3")
    ) then "R2-S4"

    else if (
      (r.device == "R1" and r.interface == "Ethernet1") or
      (r.device == "S1" and r.interface == "Ethernet1")
    ) then "R1-S1"

    else if (
      (r.device == "R2" and r.interface == "Ethernet1") or
      (r.device == "S2" and r.interface == "Ethernet1")
    ) then "R2-S2"

    else if (
      (r.device == "S1" and r.interface == "Ethernet2") or
      (r.device == "S2" and r.interface == "Ethernet2")
    ) then "S1-S2"

    else "",

  endpoint_up:
    if r._value == "UP" then 1 else 0
}))

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.id != "")
  |> group(columns: ["id"])
  |> sum(column: "endpoint_up")

|> map(fn: (r) => ({
  r with
  link_up: if r.endpoint_up == 2 then 1 else 0
}))

|> map(fn: (r) => ({
  r with

  source:
    if r.id == "R1-S1" then "R1"
    else if r.id == "R1-S3" then "R1"
    else if r.id == "R2-S2" then "R2"
    else if r.id == "R2-S4" then "R2"
    else if r.id == "R3-R4" then "R3"
    else if r.id == "R3-S3" then "R3"
    else if r.id == "R4-S4" then "R4"
    else if r.id == "S1-S2" then "S1"
    else if r.id == "S3-S4" then "S3"
    else "",

  target:
    if r.id == "R1-S1" then "S1"
    else if r.id == "R1-S3" then "S3"
    else if r.id == "R2-S2" then "S2"
    else if r.id == "R2-S4" then "S4"
    else if r.id == "R3-R4" then "R4"
    else if r.id == "R3-S3" then "S3"
    else if r.id == "R4-S4" then "S4"
    else if r.id == "S1-S2" then "S2"
    else if r.id == "S3-S4" then "S4"
    else "",

  source_if:
    if r.id == "R1-S1" then "Ethernet1"
    else if r.id == "R1-S3" then "Ethernet2"
    else if r.id == "R2-S2" then "Ethernet1"
    else if r.id == "R2-S4" then "Ethernet3"
    else if r.id == "R3-R4" then "GigabitEthernet2"
    else if r.id == "R3-S3" then "GigabitEthernet4"
    else if r.id == "R4-S4" then "GigabitEthernet3"
    else if r.id == "S1-S2" then "Ethernet2"
    else if r.id == "S3-S4" then "Ethernet1"
    else "",

  target_if:
    if r.id == "R1-S1" then "Ethernet1"
    else if r.id == "R1-S3" then "Ethernet2"
    else if r.id == "R2-S2" then "Ethernet1"
    else if r.id == "R2-S4" then "ethernet-1/3"
    else if r.id == "R3-R4" then "GigabitEthernet2"
    else if r.id == "R3-S3" then "Ethernet3"
    else if r.id == "R4-S4" then "ethernet-1/2"
    else if r.id == "S1-S2" then "Ethernet2"
    else if r.id == "S3-S4" then "ethernet-1/1"
    else "",

  link_status:
    if r.link_up == 1 then "UP" else "DOWN"
}))

|> group()
|> sort(columns: ["id"])

from(bucket: "ana-lab")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "net_ifcounters" and
    (
      r._field == "in_octets" or
      r._field == "out_octets"
    )
  )

  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    (r.device == "R1" and (r.interface == "Ethernet1" or r.interface == "Ethernet2")) or
    (r.device == "R2" and (r.interface == "Ethernet1" or r.interface == "Ethernet3")) or
    (r.device == "R3" and (r.interface == "GigabitEthernet2" or r.interface == "GigabitEthernet4")) or
    (r.device == "R4" and r.interface == "GigabitEthernet3") or
    (r.device == "S1" and r.interface == "Ethernet2") or
    (r.device == "S3" and r.interface == "Ethernet1")
  )

  |> aggregateWindow(
    every: 10s,
    fn: last,
    createEmpty: false
  )

  |> derivative(
    unit: 1s,
    nonNegative: true
  )

  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with
    _value: float(v: r._value) * 8.0
  }))

  |> group(columns: ["device", "interface", "_field"])
  |> last()
  |> group()

  |> pivot(
    rowKey: ["device", "interface"],
    columnKey: ["_field"],
    valueColumn: "_value"
  )

  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with
    id:
      if r.device == "R1" and r.interface == "Ethernet1" then "R1-S1"
      else if r.device == "R1" and r.interface == "Ethernet2" then "R1-S3"
      else if r.device == "R2" and r.interface == "Ethernet1" then "R2-S2"
      else if r.device == "R2" and r.interface == "Ethernet3" then "R2-S4"
      else if r.device == "R3" and r.interface == "GigabitEthernet2" then "R3-R4"
      else if r.device == "R3" and r.interface == "GigabitEthernet4" then "R3-S3"
      else if r.device == "R4" and r.interface == "GigabitEthernet3" then "R4-S4"
      else if r.device == "S1" and r.interface == "Ethernet2" then "S1-S2"
      else if r.device == "S3" and r.interface == "Ethernet1" then "S3-S4"
      else "",

    rx_bps: r.in_octets,
    tx_bps: r.out_octets,
    total_bps: r.in_octets + r.out_octets
  }))

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.id != "")
  |> keep(columns: [
    "id",
    "device",
    "interface",
    "rx_bps",
    "tx_bps",
    "total_bps"
  ])
  |> sort(columns: ["id"])

// LINK HEALTH
// ============================================================
import "math"
health =
  from(bucket: "ana-lab")
    |> range(start: -10m)
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._measurement == "net_ifstate" and
      r._field == "oper_status" and
      r.device != "R5"
    )
    |> group(columns: ["device", "interface"])
    |> last()

    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with

      id:
        if (
          (r.device == "R3" and r.interface == "GigabitEthernet2") or
          (r.device == "R4" and r.interface == "GigabitEthernet2")
        ) then "R3-R4"

        else if (
          (r.device == "R3" and r.interface == "GigabitEthernet4") or
          (r.device == "S3" and r.interface == "Ethernet3")
        ) then "R3-S3"

        else if (
          (r.device == "R4" and r.interface == "GigabitEthernet3") or
          (r.device == "S4" and r.interface == "ethernet-1/2")
        ) then "R4-S4"

        else if (
          (r.device == "S3" and r.interface == "Ethernet1") or
          (r.device == "S4" and r.interface == "ethernet-1/1")
        ) then "S3-S4"

        else if (
          (r.device == "R1" and r.interface == "Ethernet2") or
          (r.device == "S3" and r.interface == "Ethernet2")
        ) then "R1-S3"

        else if (
          (r.device == "R2" and r.interface == "Ethernet3") or
          (r.device == "S4" and r.interface == "ethernet-1/3")
        ) then "R2-S4"

        else if (
          (r.device == "R1" and r.interface == "Ethernet1") or
          (r.device == "S1" and r.interface == "Ethernet1")
        ) then "R1-S1"

        else if (
          (r.device == "R2" and r.interface == "Ethernet1") or
          (r.device == "S2" and r.interface == "Ethernet1")
        ) then "R2-S2"

        else if (
          (r.device == "S1" and r.interface == "Ethernet2") or
          (r.device == "S2" and r.interface == "Ethernet2")
        ) then "S1-S2"

        else "",

      endpoint_up:
        if r._value == "UP" then 1 else 0
    }))

    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.id != "")
    |> group(columns: ["id"])
    |> sum(column: "endpoint_up")

    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with

      link_up:
        if r.endpoint_up == 2 then 1 else 0,

      source:
        if r.id == "R1-S1" then "R1"
        else if r.id == "R1-S3" then "R1"
        else if r.id == "R2-S2" then "R2"
        else if r.id == "R2-S4" then "R2"
        else if r.id == "R3-R4" then "R3"
        else if r.id == "R3-S3" then "R3"
        else if r.id == "R4-S4" then "R4"
        else if r.id == "S1-S2" then "S1"
        else if r.id == "S3-S4" then "S3"
        else "",

      target:
        if r.id == "R1-S1" then "S1"
        else if r.id == "R1-S3" then "S3"
        else if r.id == "R2-S2" then "S2"
        else if r.id == "R2-S4" then "S4"
        else if r.id == "R3-R4" then "R4"
        else if r.id == "R3-S3" then "S3"
        else if r.id == "R4-S4" then "S4"
        else if r.id == "S1-S2" then "S2"
        else if r.id == "S3-S4" then "S4"
        else "",

      source_if:
        if r.id == "R1-S1" then "Ethernet1"
        else if r.id == "R1-S3" then "Ethernet2"
        else if r.id == "R2-S2" then "Ethernet1"
        else if r.id == "R2-S4" then "Ethernet3"
        else if r.id == "R3-R4" then "GigabitEthernet2"
        else if r.id == "R3-S3" then "GigabitEthernet4"
        else if r.id == "R4-S4" then "GigabitEthernet3"
        else if r.id == "S1-S2" then "Ethernet2"
        else if r.id == "S3-S4" then "Ethernet1"
        else "",

      target_if:
        if r.id == "R1-S1" then "Ethernet1"
        else if r.id == "R1-S3" then "Ethernet2"
        else if r.id == "R2-S2" then "Ethernet1"
        else if r.id == "R2-S4" then "ethernet-1/3"
        else if r.id == "R3-R4" then "GigabitEthernet2"
        else if r.id == "R3-S3" then "Ethernet3"
        else if r.id == "R4-S4" then "ethernet-1/2"
        else if r.id == "S1-S2" then "Ethernet2"
        else if r.id == "S3-S4" then "ethernet-1/1"
        else "",

      link_status:
        if r.endpoint_up == 2 then "UP" else "DOWN"

    |> keep(columns: [
      "id",
      "endpoint_up",
      "link_up",
      "source",
      "target",
      "source_if",
      "target_if",
      "link_status"
    ])
    |> group()


// ============================================================
// LINK TRAFFIC
// ============================================================

traffic =
  from(bucket: "ana-lab")
    |> range(start: -5m)
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._measurement == "net_ifcounters" and
      (
        r._field == "in_octets" or
        r._field == "out_octets"
      )
    )

    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      (r.device == "R1" and
        (r.interface == "Ethernet1" or r.interface == "Ethernet2")) or

      (r.device == "R2" and
        (r.interface == "Ethernet1" or r.interface == "Ethernet3")) or

      (r.device == "R3" and
        (r.interface == "GigabitEthernet2" or
         r.interface == "GigabitEthernet4")) or

      (r.device == "R4" and
        r.interface == "GigabitEthernet3") or

      (r.device == "S1" and
        r.interface == "Ethernet2") or

      (r.device == "S3" and
        r.interface == "Ethernet1")
    )

    |> aggregateWindow(
      every: 10s,
      fn: last,
      createEmpty: false
    )

    |> derivative(
      unit: 1s,
      nonNegative: true
    )

    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      _value: float(v: r._value) * 8.0
    }))

    |> group(columns: ["device", "interface", "_field"])
    |> last()
    |> group()

    |> pivot(
      rowKey: ["device", "interface"],
      columnKey: ["_field"],
      valueColumn: "_value"
    )

    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with

      id:
        if r.device == "R1" and r.interface == "Ethernet1"
          then "R1-S1"

        else if r.device == "R1" and r.interface == "Ethernet2"
          then "R1-S3"

        else if r.device == "R2" and r.interface == "Ethernet1"
          then "R2-S2"

        else if r.device == "R2" and r.interface == "Ethernet3"
          then "R2-S4"

        else if r.device == "R3" and r.interface == "GigabitEthernet2"
          then "R3-R4"

        else if r.device == "R3" and r.interface == "GigabitEthernet4"
          then "R3-S3"

        else if r.device == "R4" and r.interface == "GigabitEthernet3"
          then "R4-S4"

        else if r.device == "S1" and r.interface == "Ethernet2"
          then "S1-S2"

        else if r.device == "S3" and r.interface == "Ethernet1"
          then "S3-S4"

        else "",

      rx_bps: r.in_octets,
      tx_bps: r.out_octets,
      total_bps: r.in_octets + r.out_octets
    }))

    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.id != "")
    |> keep(columns: [
      "id",
      "rx_bps",
      "tx_bps",
      "total_bps"
    ])
    |> group()


// ============================================================
// COMBINE HEALTH + TRAFFIC
// ============================================================

join(
  tables: {
    health: health,
    traffic: traffic
  },
  on: ["id"],
  method: "inner"
)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with

    rx_display:
      if r.rx_bps >= 1000000.0 then
        string(v: int(v: math.round(x: r.rx_bps / 1000000.0))) + " Mb/s"
      else if r.rx_bps >= 1000.0 then
        string(v: int(v: math.round(x: r.rx_bps / 1000.0))) + " Kb/s"
      else
        string(v: int(v: math.round(x: r.rx_bps))) + " bps",

    tx_display:
      if r.tx_bps >= 1000000.0 then
        string(v: int(v: math.round(x: r.tx_bps / 1000000.0))) + " Mb/s"
      else if r.tx_bps >= 1000.0 then
        string(v: int(v: math.round(x: r.tx_bps / 1000.0))) + " Kb/s"
      else
        string(v: int(v: math.round(x: r.tx_bps))) + " bps",

    total_display:
      if r.total_bps >= 1000000.0 then
        string(v: int(v: math.round(x: r.total_bps / 1000000.0))) + " Mb/s"
      else if r.total_bps >= 1000.0 then
        string(v: int(v: math.round(x: r.total_bps / 1000.0))) + " Kb/s"
      else
        string(v: int(v: math.round(x: r.total_bps))) + " bps"
  }))
  |> keep(columns: [
    "id",
    "source",
    "target",
    "source_if",
    "target_if",
    "endpoint_up",
    "link_up",
    "link_status",
    "rx_bps",
    "tx_bps",
    "total_bps"
    "rx_display",
    "tx_display",
    "total_display"
  ])
  |> sort(columns: ["id"])
